summary: Tipos de fichero cuyo contenido indexa Google y cómo determina el tipo (la cabecera Content-Type). No fija requisitos por sí misma: da el método de w-consumer/004, porque Search Essentials exige que el contenido textual esté en un tipo de fichero que Google Search admite.

quotes.text: Google can index the content of most text-based files and certain encoded document formats. The file type is determined by the Content-Type HTTP header returned when Google crawls the file, though in some cases Google may use the file extension or re-parse the file using a different parser if the Content-Type header is missing or incorrect.
The following flat file types are supported. These are files where the content is stored in plain, unencoded text (though they may use markup tags).
The following encoded file types are supported. These are binary files or complex containers that require a specific parser to extract the human-readable text.
